grammarFocus: have to / must / can；一般现在时与过去时对比。
title: A Busy Week at the Office (Revised)
instructions: 这是一份模拟的英语听力练习，适合A2水平学习者。请先听录音（或阅读转录文本），然后回答问题。题目类型包括单选、填空和判断正误。填空答案必须与原文完全一致，且不超过字数限制。所有解释均为中文。注意：本材料为模拟练习，不是官方雅思考试。
transcript:
M: Hi, Lisa. How was your week?
W: Busy! I had to finish a report by Friday. I also must check the sales numbers every morning.
M: Really? I don't have to check numbers. But I can work from home on Wednesdays.
W: That's nice. I have to go to the office every day. Oh, wait—I must call the client now. Sorry.
M: No problem. Can you send me the report later?
W: Yes, I can. I'll email it after lunch.
M: Thanks. Last week, I had to work on Saturday. It was very tiring.
W: I know. I worked last Saturday too. But I don't have to work this Saturday.
M: Good. I must go now. The meeting starts in five minutes.
W: OK. Bye!
M: Wait, Lisa. Can you also send the report to Tom?
W: Tom? I can send it to him, but I must finish the sales numbers first.
M: That's fine. I can wait. Oh, and I have to call the client tomorrow. Can you help me?
W: Sure, I can help you after I send the report.
M: Great. Thanks!

questions.prompt: What did the woman have to finish by Friday?
questions.explanation: 女士说：'I had to finish a report by Friday.' 所以答案是A report。
questions.evidence: I had to finish a report by Friday.

questions.prompt: The woman must check the ______ numbers every morning. (one word)
questions.explanation: 女士说：'I also must check the sales numbers every morning.' 所以填sales。
questions.evidence: I also must check the sales numbers every morning.

questions.prompt: When can the man work from home?
questions.explanation: 男士说：'But I can work from home on Wednesdays.' 所以答案是On Wednesdays。
questions.evidence: But I can work from home on Wednesdays.

questions.prompt: What does the woman have to do every day?
questions.explanation: 女士说：'I have to go to the office every day.' 所以答案是Go to the office。
questions.evidence: I have to go to the office every day.

questions.prompt: The woman must call the ______ now. (one word)
questions.explanation: 女士说：'I must call the client now.' 所以填client。
questions.evidence: I must call the client now.

questions.prompt: What will the woman do after lunch?
questions.explanation: 女士说：'I'll email it after lunch.' 这里的it指报告，所以答案是Email the report。

questions.prompt: What did the man have to do last week?
questions.explanation: 男士说：'Last week, I had to work on Saturday.' 所以答案是Work on Saturday。
questions.evidence: Last week, I had to work on Saturday.

questions.prompt: Did the woman work last Saturday?
questions.explanation: 女士说：'I worked last Saturday too.' 所以是True。

questions.prompt: Does the woman have to work this Saturday?
questions.explanation: 女士说：'But I don't have to work this Saturday.' 所以是False。
questions.evidence: But I don't have to work this Saturday.

questions.prompt: What time does the man's meeting start?
questions.explanation: 男士说：'The meeting starts in five minutes.' 所以答案是In five minutes。
questions.evidence: The meeting starts in five minutes.

grammar.title: have to / must / can; 一般现在时与过去时对比
grammar.explanation: have to 和 must 都表示“必须”，但 have to 更强调客观需要，must 更强调主观义务。can 表示“能够”或“可以”。一般现在时表示经常性动作或事实，过去时表示过去发生的动作。例如：I have to go to the office every day.（现在）I had to work on Saturday.（过去）
grammar.example: I have to go to the office every day. / I had to work on Saturday.

questions.explanation: must 后面直接跟动词原形，不加 to，也不加 -s。所以正确的是 She must study today.
yesterday 表示过去，所以用 had to，后面跟动词原形 work。所以正确的是 I had to work yesterday.
can 后面直接跟动词原形，不加 to，也不加 -s。所以正确的是 He can swim.

options: They don't have to work on Sunday.
They don't has to work on Sunday.
They not have to work on Sunday.
They doesn't have to work on Sunday.
answers: They don't have to work on Sunday.
questions.explanation: 主语是 they，否定用 don't，后面用 have to。所以正确的是 They don't have to work on Sunday.
